verdict.rationale: Egnyte is a content platform with built-in AI features (assistant, AI search, agents), so a data-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The pack contains no statement that customer data is excluded from model training, and no opt-out control. The only training-related item describes a classification feature that users themselves train on sample documents, which is not a privacy control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
